external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Clinic In A Can has partnered with Deployed Logix to bring you a groundbreaking, complete care system that combines the strength of our container clinics with the flexibility of DLX’s soft-sided shelters. Stay tuned as we revolutionize rapid response and healthcare delivery in the most challenging environments.

In response to this pressing need, Hospitals of Hope, an NGO based in Wichita, Kansas, sponsored the purchase and donation of a Clinic In A Can Primary Care Unit. Our turn-key, containerized medical clinic was packed with durable medical supplies provided by U.S. Southern Command, hygiene kits donated by Heart to Heart International, and shelter equipment from Deployed Logix.
